test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, TRICKY is written as CXLFQH. How will PICNIC be written in that language?
solution:
The table is alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

TRICKY is written as CXLFQH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a78c5a06f753c175b40f470f75ad0c164ec72df5e0b4bf8ae4eb67d720d4f632.png] 

Similarly,

PICNIC is written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74381b31f77e925026c7abc016274cdc8ace75af529e7c5171da40b0f87a614d.png] 

Hence, 'PICNIC' is coded as "**YOFQOL**".
